create_SimpleViT_model: create a SimpleViT vision transformer model for image classification with value residual mixing
build_Transformer_blocks: build a Transformer module with depth, heads, dim_head, and learned value residual mixing across layers
create_Attention_with_value_residual: create an Attention module that supports learned value residual mixing between layers
run_SimpleViT_inference: run SimpleViT inference on a batch of images and return classification logits
test_SimpleViT_quick: test SimpleViT with a 256x256 image batch of 2 samples and 1000 output classes
